title: HeyDeer internal review evaluation
scope: Internal PR reviews across our development projects, including snaptale.com, using an internal version of HeyDeer.

runHistory.countingUnit: Recorded parent review attempts, including retries and different orchestration configurations; not unique PRs, completed independent tests, or Elo-rated rounds.

elo.roundUpdate: old Elo + sum of K * (actual - expected) over eligible pairs in the round
elo.updateTiming: Every pair in a round uses the ratings from before that round; all pairwise changes are summed and applied together after the round.
elo.roundOrder: Ascending queuedAt, then taskKey, taskVersion, and runId using JavaScript localeCompare for string tie-breaks.

methodology.scope: Organization review records only; private chat assessments are excluded.
methodology.deduplication: Keep the latest recorded revision for each task_key, task_version, and run_id, ordered by recorded_at and then revision.
methodology.adjudication: The lead reviewer supplies structured judgments and reasons. This is internal model-assisted adjudication, not independent human ground truth.

findingDefinitions.effective: An issue with verdict valid and disposition publish or fixed. Repeated, low-value, and unresolved findings receive no effective-finding credit.
findingDefinitions.exclusive: An effective issue with exactly one recorded remote contributor and no independent discovery by the lead reviewer (self). Contributor counts use the full round, not just the two reviewers being compared.
findingDefinitions.falsePositive: An issue explicitly assigned verdict false_positive. Missing feedback or an unpublished comment alone does not make a finding a false positive.
findingDefinitions.attribution: Use reviewerTaskKeys when present; otherwise use the issue's provider sources.

pairEligibility: The review has been published (githubReviewId is not null).
The dispatched and final code revisions match (headSha equals dispatchedHeadSha).
Both reviewer configurations have a succeeded reviewer in the round.
The pair has at least one effective finding or false positive across its two reviewers; otherwise it is skipped.
methodology.pairOutcome: Compare per-round scores: the higher score wins, and equal scores tie. Exclusive findings earn the bonus in addition to effective-finding credit.
methodology.baselineReviewMode: Each baseline receives one review assignment. Single pass can include multiple tool calls and internal reasoning steps.
methodology.workflowReviewMode: HeyDeer's deeper reviews use independent reviewers followed by a lead reviewer that verifies and deduplicates findings before publication. Not every review depth uses multiple reviewers.

resultDefinitions.archivedRounds: Assessed organization review rounds after exclusions and revision deduplication, within evaluationWindow.
resultDefinitions.ratedRounds: Archived rounds with at least one eligible pairwise comparison.
resultDefinitions.pairwiseComparisons: Total eligible pairwise matches. One round may produce several matches.
resultDefinitions.ratings: The full six-model comparison pool, sorted by unrounded Elo. Each row's rounds counts distinct rounds in which that model had an eligible match; comparisons counts its pairwise matches.
resultDefinitions.pairs: Wins, ties, and losses are from the left reviewer's perspective. Zero-comparison pairs are retained and do not imply a direct matchup.

articlePresentation.ratingDisplay: The article shows selected configurations and rounds Elo to the nearest integer. All ratings are calculated using the full six-model pool in this download.

systemRating.name: HeyDeer multi-round workflow
systemRating.reason: The archive scores individual reviewers, not the final workflow as an independently judged entrant.

limitations: Retrospective internal evaluation; not a randomized or independently human-labeled benchmark.
Observed configurations, sample counts, review context and time windows differ.
A single review assignment can contain multiple tool calls or internal reasoning steps.
The full six-model comparison graph is retained; Grok 4.6 and Sol have no direct comparison in this archive.
No causal estimate of multi-round uplift or matched cost-effectiveness result is available.
Elo does not include price, latency, or token use; higher Elo does not establish better cost-effectiveness.
Judgments may inherit lead-reviewer biases. The archive does not label every possible bug and does not establish recall, universal accuracy, or statistical significance.

These are historical snapshot ratings, not current dashboard ratings. Public aggregates alone cannot reconstruct chronological Elo; replay requires the private archive. Underlying PRs, source code, and raw findings are not included.

collectionWindow.coverageNote: Six-month lookback over available records; this does not imply six months of continuous observations or Elo-rated comparisons.
